name: thatsoundlikeme-tauri
description: Tauri desktop distribution of ThatSoundLikeMe for MuseHub.
author: Imitune

scripts.check: cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml -- --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.verify: npm test && npm run check && npm run build:web
scripts.dist:mac: node scripts/release-guard.cjs mac && tauri build --bundles app --target universal-apple-darwin && node scripts/zip-macos.cjs
scripts.dist:win: node scripts/release-guard.cjs win && tauri build --bundles nsis --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc --config src-tauri/tauri.windows.release.conf.json
